collisionGate.objectSummary: OpenClaw test suites: OpenClaw has three Vitest suites (unit/integration, e2e, live) and a small set of Docker runners.
Full gate before push | Most days, run `pnpm build && pnpm check && pnpm test` as the full gate expected before push.
pnpm test configuration: `pnpm test` runs unit/integration tests via `scripts/test-parallel.mjs`, which runs `vitest.unit.config.ts`, `vitest.extensions.config.ts`, and `vitest.gateway.config.ts`.
Debugging live tests | Prefer running `pnpm test:live` with narrowed live allowlists (via allowlist env vars) instead of running everything when debugging failing live cases.

Vitest vmForks behavior on Node versions: OpenClaw uses Vitest `vmForks` on Node 22/23 for faster unit shards, and automatically falls back to regular `forks` on Node 24+ to avoid Node VM linking errors (`ERR_VM_MODULE_LINK_FAILURE` / `module is already linked`). Override via `OPENCLAW_TEST_VM_FORKS=0` (force `forks`) or `OPENCLAW_TEST_VM_FORKS=1` (force `vmForks`).
Live tests credentials source and activation: Live tests source credentials from `~/.profile` and are enabled by `pnpm test:live` (sets `OPENCLAW_LIVE_TEST=1`).
Live model smoke layers: Live model smoke is split into Layer 1 (Direct model completion without gateway) and Layer 2 (Gateway + dev agent smoke).

Layer 2 gateway + dev agent smoke probes: Layer 2 (Gateway + dev agent) live smoke uses a `read` probe (write nonce file, agent reads and echoes nonce), an `exec+read` probe (agent exec-write nonce then read back), and an image probe when the model advertises image input support (expects `cat <CODE>`).
Live gateway smoke test command: Run gateway smoke with tools + image by setting OPENCLAW_LIVE_GATEWAY_MODELS and executing pnpm test:live src/gateway/gateway-models.profiles.live.test.ts.

Model selection for OPENCLAW_LIVE_GATEWAY_MODELS (tool-calling baseline) | Use at least one tool-calling baseline model per provider family in OPENCLAW_LIVE_GATEWAY_MODELS. | At least one tools-capable model per provider family (e.g., OpenAI/Anthropic/Google/Z.AI/MiniMax; optionally xAI/Mistral/Cerebras if enabled).

Model selection for OPENCLAW_LIVE_GATEWAY_MODELS (image probe) | Include at least one image-capable model in OPENCLAW_LIVE_GATEWAY_MODELS to exercise the image probe. | An image/vision-capable model variant (e.g., Claude/Gemini/OpenAI vision-capable variants) enabled for the test.

Adding regressions after live-discovered issues | When you fix a provider/model issue discovered in live, add a CI-safe regression if possible (mock/stub provider, or capture the exact request-shape transformation). If inherently live-only, keep the live test narrow and opt-in via env vars. | Avoid making inherently live-only fixes too broad; keep the live test narrow and env-gated. | Ability to create CI-safe mock/stub regressions or capture request-shape transformations; ability to keep live tests opt-in via env vars for live-only issues.

collisionGate.objectSummary: OpenClaw default test gate: `pnpm build && pnpm check && pnpm test`

Which test suite to run based on what you're changing | If editing logic/tests, run `pnpm test` (and `pnpm test:coverage` if you changed a lot). If touching gateway networking/WS protocol/pairing, add `pnpm test:e2e`. If debugging `my bot is down`/provider-specific failures/tool calling, run a narrowed `pnpm test:live`.

Live tests stability and cost: Live tests are not CI-stable by design: they require real networks, real provider policies/quotas, and may have outages; they also cost money and use rate limits. Prefer running narrowed subsets instead of "everything".

Selecting models/providers for live tests and where API keys come from: Live tests can select models via `OPENCLAW_LIVE_MODELS` (e.g., `modern`, `all`, or a comma allowlist) and select providers via `OPENCLAW_LIVE_PROVIDERS` (comma allowlist). By default, keys come from the profile store and env fallbacks; set `OPENCLAW_LIVE_REQUIRE_PROFILE_KEYS=1` to enforce profile store only.

Narrow live tests instead of running everything | When debugging real providers/models (requires real creds), prefer narrowing live tests via the allowlist env vars described below rather than running "everything".

Gateway+dev-agent live smoke probe types: Gateway+dev-agent live smoke uses `read` and `exec+read` tool probes and an image probe: it expects `cat <CODE>` from the model from an attached generated PNG, with minor OCR tolerance. Implementation references: `src/gateway/gateway-models.profiles.live.test.ts` and `src/gateway/live-image-probe.ts`.

Recommended modern live smoke models: Recommended models to cover regularly on a dev machine with keys include OpenAI `openai/gpt-5.2` (optional `openai/gpt-5.1`), OpenAI Codex `openai-codex/gpt-5.3-codex` (optional `openai-codex/gpt-5.3-codex-codex`), and Anthropic `anthropic/claude-opus-4-6` (or `anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5`).
Live gateway model matrix should use the Modern smoke set and avoid older Gemini 2.x models. | Use modern smoke set models for the live gateway matrix and avoid older Gemini 2.x models.
OPENCLAW_LIVE_GATEWAY_MODELS should include at least one vision-capable model. | Do not omit vision-capable models from OPENCLAW_LIVE_GATEWAY_MODELS.

Live tests discover credentials the same way the CLI does; profile store is preferred. | Use the CLI-style credential discovery; store profile keys in ~/.openclaw/credentials/ (preferred) and configure via ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json or OPENCLAW_CONFIG_PATH.

When adding regressions from live issues, prefer CI-safe regressions and keep live tests narrow/opt-in. | Add a CI-safe regression if possible (mock/stub provider or capture the exact request-shape transformation). | If the issue is inherently live-only (rate limits, auth policies), keep the live test narrow and opt-in via env vars.
